lead.title: London's XRlabs raises $8.4M seed led by Playground Global for its operating-room AI copilot
lead.deck: The round is led by Playground Global, with Eka Ventures. The copilot combines surgical video and patient imaging using equipment hospitals already have; the funds will expand engineering and clinical teams, open regulatory pathways (UK, Europe, US) and build the clinical evidence base.

milestone.title: Integrum's OPRA implant: 97.9% one-year survival in Ukrainian veterans with limb loss
milestone.summary: A retrospective study by Ukrainian surgeons (International Orthopaedics) covers 49 veterans operated on in 2023-2024; 45 completed both surgical stages (47 implants). Implant survival reaches 97.9% at one year and 93.2% at a median 18.7 months of follow-up, with no mechanical complications; 18% of patients had an infection in the first year.
milestone.why: Osseointegration (a prosthesis anchored in the bone, no socket) is building real-world evidence just as Ukraine decided in September on a state-funded pilot (first 25 patients in 2026). A public-demand signal for a listed Swedish medtech already MDR-certified and FDA-approved.

brefsEurope.title: Genetic Analysis presents its GA-map IBD Precision Dx test at UEG Week to predict aggressive ulcerative colitis
brefsEurope.summary: The company's first oral presentation at UEG Week (Barcelona): at diagnosis, the test identifies a microbiome profile linked to an aggressive course of ulcerative colitis, to guide treatment over the first 12 months. Developed with Akershus University Hospital and the University of Gothenburg.

brefsIntl.title: Medtronic wins CE mark for its Vitalis family of conduction system pacemakers
brefsIntl.summary: The range (ReSyncra CSP, Restoria CSP, Refina CSP, Effectra, Confirma) targets conduction system pacing, which uses the heart's natural electrical pathways. A market comparable for start-ups in physiological pacing.

brefsIntl.title: FDA clears Sequel's twiist insulin delivery system for type 2 diabetes
brefsIntl.summary: Indication extended to type 2 diabetes for Sequel's automated pump, while Dexcom awaits Medicare's decision on broader glucose-sensor coverage.

word.fr: Artificial intelligence applied to operative video
word.definition: Computer-vision models that analyze the video of an operation to document it, code it, assist the surgeon live or feed training.

parts.label: Vision model
parts.role: the brain that recognizes gestures and tissue

parts.label: Output
parts.role: report, coding, live assistance or training

how.t: The operation's video stream, often combined with patient imaging, is collected from equipment already installed in the hospital.
An AI model interprets the surgical scene to extract the steps of the procedure.
The result takes the form of an operative report or procedural coding, surgeon assistance, or training and planning material.

word.why: VC angle: surgical video is still an under-used dataset, and several young European companies are raising seeds to turn it into documentation, coding and decision support. The questions to watch are regulatory (software-as-a-medical-device status) and commercial (access to operating rooms, integration with existing systems).
